en: A black-and-white image depicting a large, well-preserved medieval castle set amidst dense green foliage. The structure is characterized by thick stone walls, multiple pointed turrets, a central tower, and high-pitched roofs. The castle sits atop a wooded hill, giving it a prominent and defensive appearance. There are no visible modern elements, and the style evokes Central European castle architecture.
